overview: The Mountain Top Mine is a high-altitude hard-rock complex in Governor Basin within the Sneffels mining district.
Federal Office of Minerals Exploration docket 6524 treats Mountain Top and Terrible No.

timeline.text: A repeatedly cited 1919 underground-mill account remains unverified from its original source and is excluded from public claims; do not label collapsed buildings as a mill without stronger evidence.

moreHistory: 3 together as a silver property, establishing their linked operating identity.
The Mountain Top system is described in mining-locality records as two major adits with several miles of underground development and silver-bearing lead-zinc-gold mineralization.
Surviving identification features include waste-rock dumps, portal areas, rail/tipple remnants, machinery, and deteriorated mine-camp structures within a heavily disturbed alpine mining landscape.
Component safeguard: keep the upper and lower Mountain Top workings, Terrible No.
3, nearby Governor Basin mines, camp structures, and transport features as separate linked elements rather than one point.
